entries.title: Roll Timing
entries.content: Dodge roll has invincibility frames (i-frames) during the middle of the animation. Roll into attacks, not away from them. Medium equip load gives a normal roll, heavy load gives a fat roll.

entries.title: Stamina Management
entries.content: Never let your stamina fully deplete — you can't dodge with zero stamina. Keep enough for at least one roll in reserve. Two-handing a weapon doesn't use more stamina than one-handing.

entries.title: Equip Load
entries.content: Stay below 70% equip load for medium roll. Below 30% for light roll (fastest). Above 70% is heavy roll — too slow to dodge effectively. Endurance and Erdtree's Favor talisman increase equip load.

entries.title: Leveling Priority
entries.content: First, level Vigor to 40 for survivability. Then your main damage stat to soft cap. Quality builds: even STR/DEX. Caster builds: Mind for FP, then INT or FTH. Don't spread points too thin.

entries.title: Guard Counters
entries.content: Block an attack with a shield, then immediately heavy attack for a guard counter. This deals massive poise damage and often staggers enemies for a critical hit. Great against humanoid bosses.

entries.title: Weapon Upgrading
entries.content: Upgrade weapons at the blacksmith using Smithing Stones. Regular weapons go to +25, Somber weapons to +10. Weapon upgrade level matters more than stats for damage. Prioritize your main weapon.

entries.title: Exploration Tips
entries.content: Use the telescope and map markers to scout areas. Golden tree seeds upgrade flasks. Sacred tears increase flask potency. Explore optional dungeons for smithing stones and talismans.

entries.title: Boss Patterns
entries.content: Watch each boss for 30 seconds before attacking — learn their combo strings. Most bosses have a punish window after their longest combo. Don't get greedy — one or two hits, then dodge.

entries.title: Spirit Ashes
entries.content: Summon spirit ashes in boss fights when the monument icon appears. Mimic Tear copies your build and is extremely strong. Summon early so spirits draw aggro while you deal damage.

entries.title: Rune Farming
entries.content: The boulder area near Lenne's Rise gives early runes. Mohgwyn Palace bird farm gives massive runes mid-game. Use the Gold Scarab talisman for 20% more runes. Pop Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot before farming.

entries.title: Status Effects
entries.content: Bleed deals percentage HP damage when the bar fills — devastating against bosses. Frost reduces damage absorption by 20%. Rot and poison deal damage over time. Many bosses are weak to bleed.

entries.title: Ashes of War
entries.content: Ashes of War change a weapon's skill and scaling. Apply them at the blacksmith or Sites of Grace. Keen adds DEX scaling, Heavy adds STR, Quality is balanced. Experiment with different weapon arts.

entries.title: NPC Questlines
entries.content: Talk to NPCs multiple times until dialogue repeats. Check Roundtable Hold after major bosses for new NPC interactions. Some quests are missable — complete them before end-game areas.

entries.title: Mounted Combat
entries.content: Use Torrent for large open-world enemies. Charge attacks from horseback deal bonus damage. You can use flasks while mounted. Dismounting has i-frames. Double jump to dodge AOE attacks.

entries.title: Flask Allocation
entries.content: Melee builds: mostly Crimson (HP) flasks with 1-2 Cerulean (FP). Casters: balanced split. You can reallocate at any Site of Grace. Wondrous Physick gives powerful custom buffs.

entries.title: Build Archetypes
entries.content: STR builds: colossal weapons, high poise, guard counter. DEX: katanas, fast attacks, bleed. INT: sorceries and magic weapons. FTH: incantations and dragon spells. Arcane: bleed and status builds.

entries.title: Parry Timing
entries.content: Small shields have the best parry frames. Parry just as the attack is about to connect. Practice on soldiers near the start. Most boss attacks can be parried — but not all. Critical hit follows.

entries.title: Crafting Essentials
entries.content: Craft Kukri for range damage. Fire pots stagger and deal good damage. Cured meat prevents poison. Warming stones heal over time. Buy cookbooks from merchants for new recipes.

entries.title: Progression Order
entries.content: Limgrave -> Liurnia -> Caelid (optional) -> Altus Plateau -> Mt. Gelmir -> Leyndell -> Mountaintops -> Consecrated Snowfield -> Haligtree -> Farum Azula. Level 60+ for Caelid, 80+ for Leyndell.

entries.title: Jump Attacks
entries.content: Jump heavy attacks deal bonus poise damage and are harder for enemies to punish. Use the Claw Talisman for 15% more jump attack damage. Great for staggering bosses for a critical hit.
